item.text:
**3B.10 Research Note**

Overall read: **mixed, leaning slightly positive on state response, but not enough to say citizens were clearly safer across the board by end-2024**. Lula’s government took several real protective steps against coup-related violence, Yanomami predation, school violence, and deforestation-linked displacement, but Brazil still had serious ongoing police abuse, prison abuse, and Yanomami insecurity during 2024.

- [Brazil marks anniversary of Jan. 8 attack on democracy](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/brazil-to-mark-anniversary-of-january-8-attack-on-democracy-3269163) — Reuters via Investing.com — 2024-01-08 — Claim: Lula responded to the January 8 domestic political-violence crisis by demanding punishment of the perpetrators rather than retaliation, collective punishment, or tolerance. This is the clearest evidence of a restrained crisis response. Question IDs: `3B.10`, `3B.1`, `3B.9`

- [PF deflagra 1ª operação do ano contra garimpo ilegal na Terra Yanomami](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/01/17/pf-deflagra-1-operacao-do-ano-contra-garimpo-ilegal-na-terra-yanomami.htm) — Reuters via UOL — 2024-01-17 — Claim: Federal police launched the first 2024 Yanomami anti-garimpo operation, part of Lula’s broader effort to suppress illegal mining that had driven disease, violence, and displacement in Indigenous territory. Question IDs: `3B.10`, `3B.7`, `3B.9`

- [Governo diz que expulsou quase todos garimpeiros de Terra Yanomami](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/09/14/governo-diz-que-expulsou-quase-todos-garimpeiros-de-terra-yanomami.htm) — Reuters via UOL — 2024-09-14 — Claim: By September, the federal government said it had nearly expelled the illegal miners who had fueled the Yanomami humanitarian crisis, with officials describing a return toward normal community life. This is strong positive evidence for reduced displacement and insecurity, though it remains official-government-backed reporting. Question IDs: `3B.10`, `3B.7`

- [Decreto Nº 12.006, de 24 de abril de 2024](https://www2.camara.leg.br/legin/fed/decret/2024/decreto-12006-24-abril-2024-795537-publicacaooriginal-171611-pe.html) — Câmara dos Deputados / Planalto text of the decree — 2024-04-24 — Claim: Lula created SNAVE, a national system to monitor and combat school violence, with reporting channels and preventive-response capacity. That is a concrete protective policy for children and school communities rather than a militarized crackdown. Question IDs: `3B.10`, `3B.7`, `3B.9`

- [Taxa de desmatamento na Amazônia cai 30,6% e 25,7% no Cerrado](https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado) — Brazil Ministry of Environment and Climate Change / INPE — 2024-11-06 — Claim: The official 2024 deforestation estimate fell sharply versus 2023, with Amazon deforestation at its lowest level in nine years. Indirectly, that reduces pressure on Indigenous, rural, and riverine communities that are exposed to displacement and predatory violence tied to land conflict. Question IDs: `3B.10`, `3B.7`

- [Crise do povo Yanomami persiste após 308 mortes em 2023, diz relatório](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/01/26/crise-do-povo-yanomami-persiste-apos-308-mortes-em-2023-diz-relatorio.htm) — Reuters via UOL — 2024-01-26 — Claim: Yanomami leaders said the crisis was still severe despite Lula’s emergency declaration, with continued invasion, malnutrition, disease, and violence, including deaths from gunshot wounds. This is the main counterevidence that the government had not fully made one of Brazil’s most vulnerable groups safe in 2024. Question IDs: `3B.10`, `3B.7`

- [Brazil should comply with rulings on police violence](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/15/brazil-comply-rulings-police-violence) — Human Rights Watch — 2024-03-15 — Claim: HRW said lethal raids, intimidation, unlawful force, and evidence tampering continued, especially in poor and Black communities, and that Brazil had not fully implemented independent-investigation requirements. This is strong counterevidence against a clean “safer by year-end” verdict. Question IDs: `3B.10`, `3B.1`, `3B.2`, `3B.6`, `3B.7`, `3B.9`

- [World Report 2025: Brazil](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2025/country-chapters/brazil) — Human Rights Watch — 2025-01-01, covering 2024 events — Claim: HRW reported continued police killings in 2024 and prison conditions marked by overcrowding and ill-treatment/torture. This is the strongest evidence that formal reforms had not yet eliminated the underlying domestic insecurity problem by the end of 2024. Question IDs: `3B.10`, `3B.1`, `3B.2`, `3B.6`, `3B.7`, `3B.9`

Search gap: I did not find a single authoritative 2024 source that cleanly isolates Lula’s net effect on national political violence, intergroup violence, or displacement versus 2023. The best evidence is fragmented across Yanomami, police abuse, school violence, and environmental displacement indicators, so the answer remains a **qualified, not definitive, improvement**.
